LanguageData.Mechanitor.scenario.name: The RobCo Mechanic
LanguageData.Mechanitor.scenario.description: People failed you long before machines ever did. You put your faith in RobCo steel, old-world code, and the quiet certainty of tools that obey. After rebuilding four service robots from scavenged parts, your work drew the wrong kind of attention. You left settled territory for an isolated stretch of wasteland where no one could confiscate your machines or tell you what they were for. Note: Your starting mechanic and specialized robots cover different jobs, but missing skills can still make this a difficult scenario.
